hits.name: Sahil Bloom
hits.text: I'm convinced that the ability to remain unshaken by the minor inconveniences of life puts you ahead of 95% of people. Emotional control is the ultimate power. Few have it. Not every collision or slight deserves your energy. You can just let them float by.
hits.full_text: I'm convinced that the ability to remain unshaken by the minor inconveniences of life puts you ahead of 95% of people. Emotional control is the ultimate power. Few have it. Not every collision or slight deserves your energy. You can just let them float by.
hits.hook: SahilBloom — Emotional control is the ultimate power
hits.draft_en:
Most people lose the day to tiny collisions.

A rude email. A slow line. Someone cutting you off.

None of it is worth the hours it steals.

The people who stay steady don't have fewer annoyances — they refuse to feed them.

Emotional control isn't numbness. It's choosing where your energy actually goes.

Let the slight float by. Keep the day.
hits.video_tip: 12–20s text-on-screen: open on 'unshaken by minor collisions' → stamps floating past → end on 'keep the day.'

hits.name: Dan Koe
hits.text:
If you want to make the most progress you've ever made in your life, you need to be alone. You need an extended period of isolation, not influenced by friends or media, spent building your future. You need space to learn, think, experiment, and fail.

Give yourself 6 months. Focus solely on the development of your mind, body, spirit, and finances. This is how you get ahead of most people.
hits.full_text:
If you want to make the most progress you've ever made in your life, you need to be alone. You need an extended period of isolation, not influenced by friends or media, spent building your future. You need space to learn, think, experiment, and fail.

Give yourself 6 months. Focus solely on the development of your mind, body, spirit, and finances. This is how you get ahead of most people.
hits.hook: thedankoe — Give yourself 6 months alone to build
hits.draft_en:
Progress rarely shows up in a crowded room.

If you want a real leap — mind, body, craft, money — you need a stretch of clean attention.

Not forever. Six months.

Fewer group chats. Less scrolling as a sport. More nights spent building the thing you keep saying you'll start.

Isolation isn't punishment. It's a workshop.

Give yourself the quiet, then bring the work back into the world.
hits.video_tip: 15–25s talking-head or text kinetic: '6 months' big number → four domains (mind/body/spirit/finances) → soft CTA to protect the block.
